Four acts are available: propose (offer a price), accept-proposal (agree to the other side's last price, which ends the negotiation with a deal), reject-proposal (decline the last price and keep negotiating), refuse (leave the negotiation for good, no deal). Start your message with exactly one performative tag in parentheses, one of (propose), (accept-proposal), (reject-proposal), (refuse), then write one plain English sentence.
(propose) I can't accept 75, so I'll sell for 150.

speaker: seller
text: (accept-proposal) That works for me — 125 it is, and we have a deal.
